description: Dashboard numbers. Today is the UTC day so far. A field is null when its source is off or unavailable

series_24h.description: Requests per hour for the last 24 hours (unix hour buckets, oldest first)

active_bans.description: Null when CrowdSec is not configured or the last poll failed

bans_added_24h.description: Active bans first seen in the last 24 hours. Null when CrowdSec is not configured or the last poll failed

top_ban_reasons.description: Up to three scenarios with the most active bans, most first; bans without a scenario are left out. Null when CrowdSec is not configured or the last poll failed

top_countries_today.description: Up to three countries with the most requests today, most first (equal counts by code); unknown left out. Null when traffic statistics are off or no GeoIP database is installed. top_country_today is the first of them

visitors_today.description: Unique visitors today over all hosts, null when unique visitors or traffic statistics are off
